blocks.zh: 學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解「定期審查 (Periodic Review)」的法規依據，以及四個維護確效狀態的品質系統（變更管制、維護、校正、偏差）
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory basis for periodic review and the four quality systems that maintain the validated state (change control, maintenance, calibration, deviation)

blocks.zh: 掌握 ISPE 科學與風險導向的分類方式：Cat 0–3 及其審查週期，並能說明 Cat 0（持續監測取代正式審查）的邏輯
blocks.en: Understand ISPE's science- and risk-based categorization: Cat 0-3 and their review intervals, and be able to explain the logic of Cat 0 (continuous monitoring in place of formal review)

blocks.zh: 熟悉 A→B→C 三層篩選流程（Triage）的設計理念，說明為何此方式比傳統全面年度審查更有效率
blocks.en: Become familiar with the design rationale of the three-tier A→B→C triage process, and explain why it is more efficient than a traditional comprehensive annual review

blocks.zh: 詳述第 A 層初步評估中四大品質系統的查詢要點，以及電腦稽核追蹤審查 (Computer Audit Trail Review) 的八個必查項目
blocks.en: Describe the Tier A initial assessment queries for the four quality systems in detail, and the eight mandatory items of Computer Audit Trail Review

blocks.zh: 應用本章知識，說明 CDMO 如何在既有設施中建立分級定期審查計畫，包括需要建立哪些量化指標與 SOP
blocks.en: Apply this chapter to explain how a CDMO can build a graded periodic review program in an existing facility, including the quantitative metrics and SOPs that need to be established

blocks.zh: 本章節內容導覽
blocks.en: Chapter Overview

blocks.zh: Introduction — 簡介
blocks.en: Introduction

blocks.zh: Regulatory requirement to maintain qualified state | 維護確效狀態的法規要求
blocks.en: Regulatory requirement to maintain qualified state

blocks.zh: 中文解說與學習重點
blocks.en: Commentary and Key Learning Points

blocks.zh: 確效狀態 (Validated / Qualified State) 的法規要求
blocks.en: Regulatory Requirements for the Validated / Qualified State

blocks.zh: 法規（ICH Q7、EU GMP Annex 15、FDA Process Validation Guidance）明確要求：確效工作不是一次性事件，而是需要持續維護。一旦系統完成確效並取得資格後，須透過品質系統確保其持續適用。
blocks.en: The regulations (ICH Q7, EU GMP Annex 15, FDA Process Validation Guidance) clearly require that validation is not a one-time event but must be maintained on an ongoing basis. Once a system has been validated and qualified, the quality system must ensure that it remains fit for use.

blocks.zh: ISPE 指出四個維護確效狀態的品質系統：
blocks.en: ISPE identifies four quality systems that maintain the validated state:

blocks.zh: 變更管制 (Change Control)：任何對設備、系統、製程的變更都必須評估對確效狀態的影響
blocks.en: Change Control: any change to equipment, systems or processes must be assessed for its impact on the validated state

blocks.zh: 維護 (Maintenance)：預防性與矯正性維護，確保設備功能正常
blocks.en: Maintenance: preventive and corrective maintenance to keep equipment functioning properly

blocks.zh: 校正 (Calibration)：量測設備的定期校正，確保數據可信
blocks.en: Calibration: periodic calibration of measuring equipment to ensure the data can be trusted

blocks.zh: 偏差 (Deviation)：偏差調查揭露系統問題並採取矯正措施
blocks.en: Deviation: deviation investigations reveal system problems and lead to corrective action

blocks.zh: 重點提示：定期審查 vs. 再確效
blocks.en: Key Point: Periodic Review vs. Requalification

blocks.zh: 定期審查 (Periodic Review)是確認系統仍維持在確效狀態的評估活動；而再確效 (Requalification)是當發現問題後需要重新執行確效測試的活動。定期審查的目的是「確認不需要再確效」或「識別需要再確效的觸發點」。
blocks.en: Periodic Review is the assessment activity that confirms a system remains in the validated state, whereas Requalification is the activity of re-executing qualification tests once a problem has been found. The purpose of periodic review is to "confirm that requalification is not needed" or to "identify the triggers for requalification".

blocks.zh: Rationale — 目的與理由
blocks.en: Rationale

blocks.zh: Regulatory expectations & science/risk-based approach | 法規期望與科學風險導向方法
blocks.en: Regulatory expectations & science/risk-based approach

blocks.zh: Table 9.1 解讀：哪些系統有明確法規要求？
blocks.en: Interpreting Table 9.1: Which Systems Have Explicit Regulatory Requirements?

blocks.zh: Table 9.1 列出的系統都是無菌製造中高風險的關鍵設備，因此法規直接規定其定期驗證頻率，不需要透過分類判斷：
blocks.en: The systems listed in Table 9.1 are all critical, high-risk equipment in sterile manufacturing, so the regulations prescribe their periodic verification frequency directly, with no need for a categorization decision:

blocks.zh: 滅菌釜 (Autoclave) / SIP / 除熱原隧道：每年年度再驗證（EU GMP Annex 1 [24]）
blocks.en: Autoclave / SIP / depyrogenation tunnel: annual revalidation (EU GMP Annex 1 [24])

blocks.zh: 無菌充填線：每半年媒體充填 (APS)（FDA 無菌指南 [23]）
blocks.en: Aseptic filling line: media fill (APS) every six months (FDA aseptic guidance [23])

blocks.zh: ISO 5/Grade A 環境 HEPA 過濾器：每半年洩漏測試
blocks.en: HEPA filters in ISO 5/Grade A environments: leak testing every six months

blocks.zh: 關鍵說明：SIP 若連續監控中，通常不需要再驗證——這正是 ISPE 「監測取代審查」邏輯的具體例子。
blocks.en: Key note: if SIP is under continuous monitoring, revalidation is generally not needed. This is a concrete example of ISPE's "monitoring replaces review" logic.

blocks.zh: 比喻：傳統年度審查 = 年底一次性大掃除
blocks.en: Analogy: Traditional Annual Review = A Once-a-Year Big Clean-Up

blocks.zh: 傳統方式是每年花大量人力把一年內所有紀錄翻出來審一遍，就像年底大掃除。問題是：
blocks.en: The traditional approach is to spend a great deal of effort every year pulling out and reviewing all of the year's records, like a year-end big clean-up. The problems are:

blocks.zh: 工作量龐大，審查人員容易疲勞，反而漏掉真正重要的異常訊號
blocks.en: The workload is enormous and reviewers get fatigued, so they may miss the signals that really matter

blocks.zh: 大部分系統運作良好，年度審查不產生附加價值——低回報、高投入
blocks.en: Most systems run well, so the annual review adds no value: low return, high effort

blocks.zh: ISPE 的科學/風險導向方法像是「設置警報器」：平時持續監控，有警報才深入調查。效率更高、同樣符合法規。
blocks.en: ISPE's science/risk-based approach is like "installing an alarm": monitor continuously in normal times and investigate in depth only when the alarm sounds. It is more efficient and equally compliant.

blocks.zh: Cat 0 的核心邏輯：持續監測 = 定期審查
blocks.en: Core Logic of Cat 0: Continuous Monitoring = Periodic Review

blocks.zh: WFI、純化水、HVAC 等關鍵公用設施已經有嚴格的日常監測計畫（TOC、電導度、微生物、粒子計數等）。ISPE 認為：這些持續監測本身就是最好的定期審查。因此這些系統被列為 Cat 0，不需要額外的正式定期審查。
blocks.en: Critical utilities such as WFI, purified water and HVAC already have rigorous routine monitoring programs (TOC, conductivity, microbiology, particle counts, etc.). ISPE holds that this continuous monitoring is itself the best periodic review. These systems are therefore classed as Cat 0 and need no additional formal periodic review.

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯相當重要——它讓組織可以將資源集中在真正需要審查的高風險系統上。
blocks.en: This logic is very important: it allows an organization to focus its resources on the high-risk systems that genuinely need review.

blocks.zh: Principles / Concepts — 原則與概念
blocks.en: Principles / Concepts

blocks.zh: Mature quality systems & 8 performance metrics | 成熟品質系統與8項績效指標
blocks.en: Mature quality systems & 8 performance metrics

blocks.zh: 8 大品質系統績效指標
blocks.en: The 8 Quality System Performance Metrics

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出定期審查最有效率的前提條件是擁有成熟的品質系統，以下 8 項指標是核心衡量點：
blocks.en: ISPE states that the precondition for the most efficient periodic review is a mature quality system. The following 8 metrics are the core measurement points:

blocks.zh: 維護計畫完成率（排程維護是否準時執行）
blocks.en: Maintenance program completion rate (whether scheduled maintenance is performed on time)

blocks.zh: 非計畫性維護 / 故障維護的頻率與重複性
blocks.en: Frequency and recurrence of unplanned maintenance / breakdown maintenance

blocks.zh: 校正計畫完成率（是否在允許時窗內完成）
blocks.en: Calibration program completion rate (whether calibrations are completed within the permitted window)

blocks.zh: 變更管制的類別與數量分布
blocks.en: Categories and distribution of change controls

blocks.zh: 偏差的類別與數量（根本原因是否指向設備）
blocks.en: Categories and numbers of deviations (whether root causes point to equipment)

blocks.zh: 電腦系統稽核追蹤審查（詳見右側專欄）
blocks.en: Computer system audit trail review (see the right-hand panel for details)

blocks.zh: 備份與歸檔驗證（GMP 關鍵數據）
blocks.en: Backup and archive verification (GMP-critical data)

blocks.zh: 品質系統整體內稽結果
blocks.en: Overall internal audit results for the quality system

blocks.zh: 電腦稽核追蹤審查 (Computer Audit Trail Review) — 8 個必查項目
blocks.en: Computer Audit Trail Review: 8 Mandatory Items

blocks.zh: 這是 Section 9.1.2 中最常被忽略的部分，FDA 21 CFR Part 11 及 EU GMP Annex 11 均有相關要求，以下 8 點必須逐項審查：
blocks.en: This is the part of Section 9.1.2 that is most often overlooked. FDA 21 CFR Part 11 and EU GMP Annex 11 both contain related requirements, and the following 8 points must each be reviewed:

blocks.zh: 通用帳號/共用帳號：確認無人使用 "admin" 或共用帳號登入
blocks.en: Generic/shared accounts: confirm that no one logs in with "admin" or a shared account

blocks.zh: 使用者存取管理：已離職或轉職員工是否已停用帳號（用戶存取管理 UAM）
blocks.en: User access management: whether accounts of departed or transferred employees have been disabled (User Access Management, UAM)

blocks.zh: 管理員操作稽核追蹤：每筆管理員操作是否均有品質系統紀錄佐證
blocks.en: Administrator activity audit trail: whether every administrator action is supported by a quality system record

blocks.zh: 一般用戶操作稽核追蹤：如適用，每筆操作是否均有紀錄佐證
blocks.en: General user activity audit trail: where applicable, whether every action is supported by a record

blocks.zh: 關鍵組態設定變更：來自數據完整性評估的關鍵設定，任何變更均須有品質系統記錄支持
blocks.en: Changes to critical configuration settings: for critical settings identified in the data integrity assessment, any change must be supported by a quality system record

blocks.zh: 稽核追蹤審查執行確認：系統管理員 SOP 與操作 SOP 規定的審查是否確實執行
blocks.en: Confirmation that audit trail reviews are performed: whether the reviews required by the system administration SOP and the operating SOP are actually carried out

blocks.zh: 品質部門審查者確認：品質部門是否作為驗證者審查了稽核追蹤
blocks.en: Confirmation by the quality unit reviewer: whether the quality unit reviewed the audit trail as the verifier

blocks.zh: 備份與歸檔：GMP 關鍵數據的備份與歸檔已驗證
blocks.en: Backup and archive: backup and archiving of GMP-critical data has been verified

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務思考：稽核追蹤審查的挑戰
blocks.en: CDMO Practical Considerations: The Challenges of Audit Trail Review

blocks.zh: 許多 CDMO 擁有多個電腦化系統（LIMS、MES、SCADA、EBR 等），每個系統都需要執行上述 8 項審查。常見缺失包括：
blocks.en: Many CDMOs have multiple computerized systems (LIMS, MES, SCADA, EBR, etc.), and each one requires the 8 reviews above. Common deficiencies include:

blocks.zh: 沒有 SOP 定義審查頻率（「定期」沒有明確定義）
blocks.en: No SOP defines the review frequency ("periodic" is not clearly defined)

blocks.zh: IT 部門執行審查但品質部門未作為驗證者
blocks.en: IT performs the review but the quality unit does not act as the verifier

blocks.zh: 共用帳號問題未被視為 GMP 違規
blocks.en: Shared account issues are not treated as GMP violations

blocks.zh: 建議：建立電腦化系統清單，每個系統指定責任人，定義審查頻率並記入 SOP。
blocks.en: Recommendation: build an inventory of computerized systems, assign an owner to each system, define the review frequency and document it in an SOP.

blocks.zh: Two-phase overview & required inputs | 兩階段架構與先決條件
blocks.en: Two-phase overview & required inputs

blocks.zh: 兩階段架構總覽
blocks.en: Overview of the Two-Phase Structure

blocks.zh: Phase 1（系統分類）：決定哪些系統需要審查、多久審查一次，是整個計畫的「前置規劃」。
blocks.en: Phase 1 (system categorization): decides which systems need review and how often; it is the "advance planning" of the whole program.

blocks.zh: Phase 2（執行）：實際執行審查，採用 A→B→C 三層篩選流程。大多數系統在 Tier A 即可完成（若無異常訊號），只有真正有問題的系統才需要深入到 Tier B 或 Tier C。
blocks.en: Phase 2 (execution): carries out the actual review using the three-tier A→B→C triage process. Most systems can be completed at Tier A (if there are no signals); only systems with real problems need to go further to Tier B or Tier C.

blocks.zh: Tier A 初步評估：查詢四大品質系統，找訊號
blocks.en: Tier A Initial Assessment: query the four quality systems and look for signals

blocks.zh: ↓ 若有異常訊號
blocks.en: ↓ If signals are found

blocks.zh: Tier B 深入評估：SME 團隊評估影響程度
blocks.en: Tier B Detailed Assessment: SME team evaluates the extent of impact

blocks.zh: ↓ 若有確效狀態疑慮
blocks.en: ↓ If there is concern about the validated state

blocks.zh: Tier C 矯正行動：定義行動、開立不符合紀錄
blocks.en: Tier C Corrective Action: define actions and raise a non-conformance record

blocks.zh: 先決條件的實務意義
blocks.en: Practical Meaning of the Prerequisites

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出的先決條件看似基本，卻常常是 CDMO 的痛點：
blocks.en: The prerequisites listed by ISPE look basic but are often a pain point for CDMOs:

blocks.zh: 確效系統清單：是否有完整且最新的清單？系統退役時是否及時移除？
blocks.en: Inventory of validated systems: is there a complete and current inventory? Are systems removed promptly when retired?

blocks.zh: 現行法規版本：是否追蹤各目標市場（FDA/EMA/PMDA）的最新版法規？
blocks.en: Current regulatory versions: are the latest versions of the regulations for each target market (FDA/EMA/PMDA) being tracked?

blocks.zh: As-built 圖面：圖面是否隨每次變更維護更新？這是最常見的缺失之一。
blocks.en: As-built drawings: are drawings kept up to date with every change? This is one of the most common deficiencies.

blocks.zh: 風險評估：若有，可以大幅加速分類決策；若無，分類仍可進行但較費時。
blocks.en: Risk assessments: if available, they can greatly speed up categorization decisions; if not, categorization can still proceed but takes longer.

blocks.zh: 比喻：多專科醫療團隊
blocks.en: Analogy: A Multidisciplinary Medical Team

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議 Tier B/C 審查由小型跨功能團隊（系統負責人、維護、品質）共同執行，就像醫院處理複雜病例時會召集多科會診。不同背景的人看到不同角度的問題，比單人審查更全面，同時也控制規模。
blocks.en: ISPE recommends that Tier B/C reviews be performed by a small cross-functional team (system owner, maintenance, quality), just as a hospital convenes a multidisciplinary consultation for a complex case. People from different backgrounds see different aspects of a problem, which is more comprehensive than a single reviewer while keeping the scale under control.

blocks.zh: Table 9.2 Categories & Table 9.3 Schedule | 系統分類與審查頻率
blocks.en: Table 9.2 Categories & Table 9.3 Schedule

blocks.zh: 系統分類 (System Categorization) 的核心邏輯
blocks.en: Core Logic of System Categorization

blocks.zh: 分類的判斷依據是對產品品質的潛在影響程度，而製程的位置（早期 vs 後期）是重要判斷因子：
blocks.en: Categorization is based on the potential impact on product quality, and the position in the process (early vs. late stage) is an important factor:

blocks.zh: 早期製程（發酵、粗純化）：後續有多道製程和測試作為篩網，設備問題較不易直接影響最終產品 → 較低風險
blocks.en: Early-stage processes (fermentation, crude purification): multiple downstream process steps and tests act as a screen, so equipment problems are less likely to affect the final product directly → lower risk

blocks.zh: 後期製程（Fill/Finish、滅菌）：直接影響最終產品品質，且後面無緩衝 → 較高風險
blocks.en: Late-stage processes (fill/finish, sterilization): these directly affect final product quality with no buffer downstream → higher risk

blocks.zh: 四個分類說明
blocks.en: The Four Categories

blocks.zh: Cat 0 無需正式定期審查：已有持續監測或每次使用均有完整性測試（如無菌過濾的完整性測試）。WFI、HVAC、壓縮空氣、包裝系統均屬此類。
blocks.en: Cat 0 No formal periodic review needed: continuous monitoring is in place, or an integrity test is performed with every use (such as the integrity test for sterilizing filtration). WFI, HVAC, compressed air and packaging systems all fall into this category.

blocks.zh: Cat 1 遵照法規規定頻率：如滅菌釜依 EU GMP Annex 1 每年再驗證，無需在此基礎上再加定期審查。
blocks.en: Cat 1 Follow the regulatory frequency: for example, autoclaves are revalidated annually under EU GMP Annex 1, and no periodic review is added on top of that.

blocks.zh: Cat 2 每2年審查：Fill/Finish 充填系統、層析純化設備等——重要但有監測作為安全網。
blocks.en: Cat 2 Review every 2 years: fill/finish filling systems, chromatography purification equipment, etc. These are important but have monitoring as a safety net.

blocks.zh: Cat 3 每3年審查：錠劑塗裝機、錠片壓製機、發酵槽等複雜系統。注意：頻率低≠不重要，而是因為系統有足夠的製程監控作為早期預警。
blocks.en: Cat 3 Review every 3 years: complex systems such as tablet coaters, tablet presses and fermenters. Note: a lower frequency does not mean less important; it is because the system has sufficient process monitoring to provide early warning.

blocks.zh: 常見誤解：Cat 3 頻率最低 = 最不重要？
blocks.en: Common Misunderstanding: Lowest Frequency for Cat 3 = Least Important?

blocks.zh: 發酵槽 (Bioreactor) 被列為 Cat 3（每3年），並非因為它不重要，而是因為製程本身有大量連續監控（pH、DO、溫度、攪拌等），這些監控數據本身就是持續的性能確認。因此不需要像高風險的 Fill/Finish (Cat 2) 那樣頻繁地正式定期審查。
blocks.en: A bioreactor is classed as Cat 3 (every 3 years) not because it is unimportant, but because the process itself has extensive continuous monitoring (pH, DO, temperature, agitation, etc.), and this monitoring data is itself ongoing performance verification. It therefore does not need formal periodic review as frequently as a high-risk fill/finish system (Cat 2).

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：如何建立系統分類清單
blocks.en: CDMO Application: How to Build the System Categorization List

blocks.zh: CDMO 實施步驟：
blocks.en: CDMO implementation steps:

blocks.zh: 建立所有已確效設備/系統的完整清單（連結到確效文件 IQ/OQ/PQ）
blocks.en: Build a complete inventory of all validated equipment/systems (linked to the IQ/OQ/PQ validation documents)

blocks.zh: 對每個系統進行分類（Cat 0–3），記錄分類依據（SME 評估意見）
blocks.en: Categorize each system (Cat 0-3) and record the basis for categorization (SME assessment comments)

blocks.zh: 根據 Table 9.3 設定審查排程，將 Cat 2 和 Cat 3 系統排入多年計畫
blocks.en: Set the review schedule according to Table 9.3, and place Cat 2 and Cat 3 systems in a multi-year plan

blocks.zh: Cat 1 系統追蹤法規規定的年度再驗證時程，不另行定期審查
blocks.en: For Cat 1 systems, track the regulatory annual revalidation schedule, with no separate periodic review

blocks.zh: 定期（至少每兩年）複審分類是否仍適當
blocks.en: Re-review periodically (at least every two years) whether the categorization is still appropriate

blocks.zh: 比喻：汽車保養 vs. 航空器大修
blocks.en: Analogy: Car Servicing vs. Aircraft Overhaul

blocks.zh: Cat 0 如同汽車的油表警示燈——持續監測，有問題才進廠。Cat 1 如同飛機的法定大修（MRO）——法規規定固定週期，不可商量。Cat 2/3 則像高鐵的定期維護——依複雜程度設定不同頻率，在排定時間進行全面評估。
blocks.en: Cat 0 is like the warning light on a car's fuel gauge: monitor continuously and go to the workshop only when there is a problem. Cat 1 is like the statutory overhaul of an aircraft (MRO): the regulations fix the cycle and it is non-negotiable. Cat 2/3 are like high-speed rail periodic maintenance: the frequency is set according to complexity, with a comprehensive assessment at the scheduled time.

blocks.zh: Three-tier triage across four quality systems | 三層篩選流程與四大品質系統
blocks.en: Three-tier triage across four quality systems

blocks.zh: 三層篩選流程：核心創新
blocks.en: The Three-Tier Triage Process: The Core Innovation

blocks.zh: 這是 ISPE 定期審查方法的最核心創新。傳統做法是對所有系統執行同樣深度的年度審查；ISPE 的三層篩選則是：
blocks.en: This is the core innovation of the ISPE periodic review approach. The traditional approach is to perform an annual review of the same depth for every system; ISPE's three-tier triage works as follows:

blocks.zh: 初步評估 (Tier A)：高層次查詢，大多數系統在此完成
blocks.en: Initial Assessment (Tier A): high-level queries; most systems are completed here

blocks.zh: ↓ 若發現異常訊號（Signal）
blocks.en: ↓ If an abnormal signal is found

blocks.zh: 深入評估 (Tier B)：SME 評估，若無疑慮即完成
blocks.en: Detailed Assessment (Tier B): SME evaluation; complete if there is no concern

blocks.zh: ↓ 若對確效狀態有疑慮
blocks.en: ↓ If there is concern about the validated state

blocks.zh: 矯正行動 (Tier C)：制定行動計畫，開立不符合紀錄
blocks.en: Corrective Action (Tier C): develop an action plan and raise a non-conformance record

blocks.zh: 關鍵點：沒有訊號 = 審查完成，不需要為了「看起來做了很多工作」而進行無謂的深入審查。
blocks.en: Key point: no signal = review complete. There is no need to carry out pointless deep reviews just to "look like a lot of work has been done".

blocks.zh: 四大品質系統 × 三個層級 = 12 個評估模塊
blocks.en: Four Quality Systems × Three Tiers = 12 Assessment Modules

blocks.zh: 這個矩陣結構讓審查工作模組化：每個品質系統獨立評估，發現訊號的才升級到下一層，未發現訊號的即完成。例如：Tier A 查完四個系統，發現只有「偏差系統」有訊號，則只有偏差系統升級到 Tier B 評估，其餘三個系統的審查已完成。
blocks.en: This matrix structure makes the review work modular: each quality system is assessed independently, only those with signals escalate to the next tier, and those without signals are complete. For example: if Tier A queries all four systems and finds a signal only in the "deviation system", only the deviation system escalates to Tier B, and the review of the other three systems is complete.

blocks.zh: 比喻：急診分診 (Triage) 機制
blocks.en: Analogy: Emergency Room Triage

blocks.zh: ISPE 直接使用了 "triage process" 這個詞。急診分診的邏輯是：不是所有病人都需要立即手術，而是依嚴重程度分配醫療資源。同樣地，定期審查不是所有系統都需要深度調查，而是有訊號才深入，無訊號即完成，確保資源用在真正需要的地方。
blocks.en: ISPE uses the term "triage process" directly. The logic of emergency triage is that not every patient needs immediate surgery; medical resources are allocated by severity. Likewise, in periodic review not every system needs an in-depth investigation: investigate in depth when there is a signal, and finish when there is none, ensuring resources go where they are really needed.

blocks.zh: 「評估期間」的重要性
blocks.en: The Importance of the "Assessment Period"

blocks.zh: 評估期間 (Assessment Period) = 自上次定期審查結束（或原始確效完成）至今的時間段。所有查詢均針對此期間的紀錄，確保審查的全面性且不遺漏過渡期的問題。
blocks.en: The Assessment Period is the time span from the end of the last periodic review (or completion of the original qualification) to the present. All queries cover records for this period, ensuring the review is comprehensive and does not miss problems from the intervening time.

blocks.zh: 當首次導入定期審查計畫時，ISPE 允許在類別規定的時間框架內分批完成（例如 Cat 2 系統可在前兩年內陸續完成首次審查），不需要立刻全部完成。
blocks.en: When a periodic review program is first introduced, ISPE allows the initial reviews to be completed in batches within the time frame specified for each category (for example, Cat 2 systems can be completed one after another within the first two years); they do not all need to be completed immediately.

blocks.zh: High-level signal detection across four quality systems | A 層：高層次異常訊號偵測
blocks.en: High-level signal detection across four quality systems

blocks.zh: Tier A：四大品質系統的查詢重點
blocks.en: Tier A: Query Focus for the Four Quality Systems

blocks.zh: Tier A 是純粹的查詢與篩選，不需要深度分析，目的是找到「訊號 (Signal)」：
blocks.en: Tier A is purely querying and screening. It requires no in-depth analysis, and its purpose is to find "signals":

blocks.zh: GMP 合規：若組織已有主動追蹤法規變化的系統，此項可免查。若無，則需檢視評估期間是否有法規修訂影響目前的確效範疇。
blocks.en: GMP compliance: if the organization already has a system for proactively tracking regulatory changes, this item can be skipped. If not, check whether any regulatory revisions during the assessment period affect the current scope of validation.

blocks.zh: 變更管制：查詢評估期間是否有需申報且影響確效的變更。低風險/不可申報的變更不需要審查。
blocks.en: Change control: query whether there were any reportable changes that affect the validated state during the assessment period. Low-risk/non-reportable changes do not need to be reviewed.

blocks.zh: 維護/校正：查詢是否有重複的矯正性維護 (Corrective Maintenance)——這是設備退化的早期警訊。
blocks.en: Maintenance/calibration: query for repeated corrective maintenance (CM), which is an early warning of equipment degradation.

blocks.zh: 偏差：查詢根本原因指向設備的偏差，且有產品品質影響。已評估為低風險的偏差不需要審查。
blocks.en: Deviation: query for deviations whose root cause points to equipment and which have a product quality impact. Deviations already assessed as low risk do not need to be reviewed.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：矯正性維護 vs. 預防性維護
blocks.en: Key Terms: Corrective vs. Preventive Maintenance

blocks.zh: 預防性維護 (Preventive Maintenance, PM)：依預定排程執行的例行維護，如定期更換耗材、潤滑保養。PM 按時完成是品質系統成熟的指標。
blocks.en: Preventive Maintenance (PM): routine maintenance performed on a predetermined schedule, such as regular replacement of consumables and lubrication. Completing PM on time is an indicator of a mature quality system.

blocks.zh: 矯正性維護 (Corrective Maintenance, CM)：設備故障後才執行的維修。重複發生的 CM（Repeated CM）是 Tier A 審查的觸發訊號——表示設備可能有系統性退化問題，需要進一步評估是否影響確效狀態。
blocks.en: Corrective Maintenance (CM): repair performed after equipment failure. Repeated CM is a trigger signal in the Tier A review. It indicates that the equipment may have systematic degradation, and further assessment is needed to determine whether the validated state is affected.

blocks.zh: GMP 合規評估的條件邏輯（重要！）
blocks.en: Conditional Logic of the GMP Compliance Assessment (Important!)

blocks.zh: ISPE 允許組織用「主動法規追蹤系統」取代 Tier A 的 GMP 合規評估。這意味著：若公司已建立定期追蹤 FDA/EMA/各地衛生主管機關法規更新並採取行動的程序，則這個品質系統的 Tier A 評估可以免除。這是 ISPE 避免重複工作的實用設計。
blocks.en: ISPE allows an organization to replace the Tier A GMP compliance assessment with a "proactive regulatory tracking system". This means that if the company has already established a procedure for regularly tracking regulatory updates from the FDA, EMA and other health authorities and acting on them, the Tier A assessment for this quality system can be waived. This is a practical ISPE design to avoid duplicated work.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：建立 Tier A 查詢模板
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: Building a Tier A Query Template

blocks.zh: 建議為每個系統建立標準化查詢模板，內容包含：
blocks.en: It is recommended to create a standardized query template for each system, containing:

blocks.zh: 系統名稱與識別碼
blocks.en: System name and identifier

blocks.zh: 評估期間（起始日期 ~ 當前日期）
blocks.en: Assessment period (start date to current date)

blocks.zh: 各品質系統查詢結果（有/無訊號）
blocks.en: Query results for each quality system (signal / no signal)

blocks.zh: 若有訊號：列出訊號描述，決定是否升級至 Tier B
blocks.en: If there is a signal: describe the signal and decide whether to escalate to Tier B

blocks.zh: 審查者簽名與日期
blocks.en: Reviewer signature and date

blocks.zh: 大多數系統在 Tier A 應可在 15–30 分鐘內完成查詢（假設品質系統已良好維護且可快速查詢）。
blocks.en: Most systems should be able to complete the Tier A queries in 15-30 minutes (assuming the quality systems are well maintained and can be searched quickly).

blocks.zh: Deeper SME review of flagged quality systems | B 層：SME 深入評估有訊號的品質系統
blocks.en: Deeper SME review of flagged quality systems

blocks.zh: Tier B：從「有訊號」到「有疑慮」的判斷
blocks.en: Tier B: Judging from "Signal" to "Concern"

blocks.zh: Tier B 的核心問題是：「這個訊號是否影響系統的確效狀態？」
blocks.en: The core question of Tier B is: "Does this signal affect the validated state of the system?"

blocks.zh: Tier A 只是確認「有訊號存在」，而 Tier B 需要 SME 團隊做出品質判斷：
blocks.en: Tier A only confirms that "a signal exists", whereas Tier B requires the SME team to make a quality judgment:

blocks.zh: 變更的數量/類型是否顯示系統已超出確效範疇？
blocks.en: Do the number/types of changes indicate that the system has moved outside its validated scope?

blocks.zh: 重複的矯正性維護是否代表設備已無法穩定執行關鍵功能？
blocks.en: Does repeated corrective maintenance mean the equipment can no longer perform its critical functions reliably?

blocks.zh: 偏差的發生是否呈現系統性趨勢，顯示系統不再處於確效狀態？
blocks.en: Do the deviations show a systematic trend, indicating that the system is no longer in the validated state?

blocks.zh: Tier B 結論分兩種：無疑慮→完成 或 有疑慮→升級至 Tier C。
blocks.en: There are two Tier B conclusions: no concern → complete or concern → escalate to Tier C.

blocks.zh: Tier B 的「範圍限制」原則
blocks.en: The "Scope Limitation" Principle of Tier B

blocks.zh: 重要：Tier B 只針對 Tier A 中被標記的品質系統 執行。若 Tier A 評估四個品質系統，只有「維護/校正系統」發現訊號，則 Tier B 只需評估維護/校正，不需要重新評估其他三個。
blocks.en: Important: Tier B is performed only for the quality systems flagged in Tier A. If Tier A assesses four quality systems and finds a signal only in the "maintenance/calibration system", Tier B needs to assess only maintenance/calibration and does not need to reassess the other three.

blocks.zh: 這個設計確保審查工作與風險對應——有問題才深入，有效控制總工作量。
blocks.en: This design ensures the review effort corresponds to the risk: investigate in depth only when there is a problem, which effectively controls the total workload.

blocks.zh: 比喻：醫療診斷的逐步深入
blocks.en: Analogy: Step-by-Step Deepening in Medical Diagnosis

blocks.zh: Tier A 是抽血檢查報告（快速篩選），Tier B 是看診時醫生詳細問診與理學檢查（深入評估），Tier C 是安排進一步檢查與治療（矯正行動）。醫生（SME）在 Tier B 做出臨床判斷：這個異常是否需要進一步處置？
blocks.en: Tier A is the blood test report (quick screening), Tier B is the doctor's detailed history-taking and physical examination during the consultation (in-depth assessment), and Tier C is arranging further tests and treatment (corrective action). At Tier B the doctor (SME) makes a clinical judgment: does this abnormality need further action?

blocks.zh: Tier B 評估的文件要求
blocks.en: Documentation Requirements for the Tier B Assessment

blocks.zh: Tier B 需要形成書面評估記錄，記錄：
blocks.en: Tier B requires a written assessment record documenting:

blocks.zh: 升級原因（來自 Tier A 的哪個訊號）
blocks.en: Reason for escalation (which signal from Tier A)

blocks.zh: SME 團隊成員（系統負責人、維護代表、品質部門）
blocks.en: SME team members (system owner, maintenance representative, quality unit)

blocks.zh: 評估依據（具體審查的紀錄編號或數據）
blocks.en: Basis of the assessment (specific record numbers or data reviewed)

blocks.zh: 結論：有無確效狀態疑慮
blocks.en: Conclusion: whether there is a concern about the validated state

blocks.zh: 若無疑慮：記錄審查完成，系統仍處於確效狀態
blocks.en: If no concern: record that the review is complete and the system remains in the validated state

blocks.zh: 若有疑慮：升級至 Tier C，啟動矯正行動
blocks.en: If there is a concern: escalate to Tier C and initiate corrective action

blocks.zh: Defining actions to restore qualified state | C 層：制定矯正行動恢復確效狀態
blocks.en: Defining actions to restore qualified state

blocks.zh: Tier C：從「疑慮」到「行動」的閉環
blocks.en: Tier C: Closing the Loop from "Concern" to "Action"

blocks.zh: Tier C 是品質系統的矯正循環，確保發現的問題得到正式追蹤與解決：
blocks.en: Tier C is the corrective loop of the quality system, ensuring that the problems found are formally tracked and resolved:

blocks.zh: 開立不符合紀錄 (Non-Conformance Record)：正式記錄問題，確保可追蹤
blocks.en: Raise a Non-Conformance Record: formally document the problem so that it is traceable

blocks.zh: 定義矯正行動：可能包括再確效測試、文件更新、設備修復等
blocks.en: Define corrective actions: these may include requalification testing, document updates, equipment repair, etc.

blocks.zh: 更新文件：確效文件、圖面、SOP 必須反映系統現狀
blocks.en: Update documents: validation documents, drawings and SOPs must reflect the current state of the system

blocks.zh: 追蹤完成狀態：透過 CAPA 系統確認行動完成並有效
blocks.en: Track completion status: confirm through the CAPA system that actions are completed and effective

blocks.zh: Tier C 可能觸發的行動類型
blocks.en: Types of Actions Tier C May Trigger

blocks.zh: 依據問題嚴重程度，Tier C 可能觸發：
blocks.en: Depending on the severity of the problem, Tier C may trigger:

blocks.zh: 文件更新：更新 as-built 圖面、SOPs、確效計畫
blocks.en: Document updates: update as-built drawings, SOPs, validation plans

blocks.zh: 補充確效測試：針對特定功能執行補充 OQ 或 PQ 測試
blocks.en: Supplementary qualification testing: perform supplementary OQ or PQ tests for specific functions

blocks.zh: 完整再確效 (Requalification)：若系統已顯著變更或性能嚴重偏離
blocks.en: Full Requalification: if the system has changed significantly or its performance has deviated seriously

blocks.zh: 設備更換或升級：若矯正性維護已無法解決根本問題
blocks.en: Equipment replacement or upgrade: if corrective maintenance can no longer resolve the root problem

blocks.zh: 製程調整：若問題來自製程參數而非設備本身
blocks.en: Process adjustment: if the problem comes from process parameters rather than the equipment itself

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：Tier C 與 CAPA 系統的整合
blocks.en: CDMO Application: Integrating Tier C with the CAPA System

blocks.zh: 建議將 Tier C 的矯正行動直接整合入公司的 CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) 系統：
blocks.en: It is recommended to integrate Tier C corrective actions directly into the company's CAPA (Corrective and Preventive Action) system:

blocks.zh: 以「定期審查」作為 CAPA 觸發來源類別
blocks.en: Use "periodic review" as a CAPA trigger source category

blocks.zh: 在 CAPA 中記錄根本原因分析（如偏差/維護趨勢）
blocks.en: Record the root cause analysis in the CAPA (e.g. deviation/maintenance trends)

blocks.zh: 設定行動完成期限與責任人
blocks.en: Set action completion deadlines and owners

blocks.zh: CAPA 關閉前需有效性評估（Effectiveness Check）
blocks.en: Require an effectiveness check before the CAPA is closed

blocks.zh: 關閉後更新定期審查記錄，確認系統已恢復確效狀態
blocks.en: After closure, update the periodic review record to confirm the system has been restored to the validated state

blocks.zh: 章節總結 Section Summary — Chapter 9: Periodic Review
blocks.en: Section Summary: Chapter 9: Periodic Review

blocks.zh: 本章介紹了 ISPE 科學與風險導向的定期審查方法，主要架構如下：
blocks.en: This chapter introduced ISPE's science- and risk-based periodic review approach. Its main structure is as follows:

blocks.zh: 法規基礎：法規要求維護確效狀態，四大品質系統（變更管制、維護、校正、偏差）加上定期審查共同支撐這個要求。
blocks.en: Regulatory basis: the regulations require the validated state to be maintained; the four quality systems (change control, maintenance, calibration, deviation) together with periodic review jointly support this requirement.

blocks.zh: 關鍵創新 — Cat 0 的邏輯：WFI、HVAC 等關鍵公用設施已有持續監測計畫，持續監測本身即為最佳定期審查，因此 Cat 0 系統無需正式定期審查。
blocks.en: Key innovation: the logic of Cat 0: critical utilities such as WFI and HVAC already have continuous monitoring programs, and continuous monitoring is itself the best periodic review, so Cat 0 systems need no formal periodic review.

blocks.zh: 系統分類 (Phase 1)：依產品品質影響風險分為 Cat 0–3；Cat 2 每2年、Cat 3 每3年執行定期審查；Cat 1 遵照法規規定的固定頻率（如滅菌釜年度再驗證）。
blocks.en: System categorization (Phase 1): systems are divided into Cat 0-3 by risk to product quality; Cat 2 is reviewed every 2 years and Cat 3 every 3 years; Cat 1 follows the fixed frequency set by regulation (e.g. annual autoclave revalidation).

blocks.zh: 三層篩選流程 (Phase 2)：Tier A → B → C 的漸進深入設計，大多數系統在 Tier A 即完成審查（無訊號），只有真正有問題的系統才需要深入調查，大幅提升效率。
blocks.en: Three-tier triage process (Phase 2): the progressive A → B → C design means most systems complete review at Tier A (no signals), and only systems with real problems need in-depth investigation, greatly improving efficiency.

blocks.zh: 電腦稽核追蹤審查：Section 9.1.2 列出的 8 個必查項目（含使用者存取管理、管理員操作追蹤、備份驗證等）是數據完整性合規的重要組成，常被忽略。
blocks.en: Computer audit trail review: the 8 mandatory items listed in Section 9.1.2 (including user access management, administrator activity tracking and backup verification) are an important part of data integrity compliance and are often overlooked.

blocks.zh: 先決條件：完整的確效系統清單、最新法規版本、as-built 圖面、品質系統歷史紀錄是執行本方法的基礎。
blocks.en: Prerequisites: a complete inventory of validated systems, current regulatory versions, as-built drawings and quality system history records are the foundation for applying this approach.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的啟示：導入此方法的優先事項是 (1) 建立系統分類清單 (2) 確保品質系統可快速查詢 (3) 建立電腦稽核追蹤 SOP (4) 培訓跨功能審查團隊。初次導入可依 Cat 2/3 的時間框架分批完成所有系統的首次審查。
blocks.en: Implications for CDMOs: the priorities for adopting this approach are (1) build a system categorization list, (2) ensure the quality systems can be queried quickly, (3) establish a computer audit trail SOP, and (4) train a cross-functional review team. On first introduction, the initial reviews of all systems can be completed in batches within the Cat 2/3 time frames.
